profile.headline: Senior Full-Stack Engineer | Angular, .NET, TypeScript, SQL
profile.summary:
Senior full-stack engineer with 5 years of experience building enterprise applications in Angular, TypeScript, .NET, and SQL. I specialize in reusable systems, accessibility, and complex regulatory workflows for government and enterprise environments.

At Kunz Leigh and Associates, I created a reusable full-stack audit framework adopted across multiple company products, led WCAG/Section 508 remediation that passed Michigan state accessibility review, and shipped software used in statewide government systems. My work has included shared Angular component libraries, .NET backend libraries, LIMS integrations, legacy data migrations, Playwright test coverage, and production support across client-facing systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Created KLA.Audits, a reusable Angular Nx + .NET audit framework adopted across multiple company products.

- Led WCAG/Section 508 remediation for State of Michigan applications, improving responsive reflow, keyboard navigation, focus management, and JAWS/NVDA screen reader support.

- Fixed accessibility, UI behavior, and reusable component defects in shared Angular wrapper components used across 10+ company projects.

- Led full-stack development of Sample Analysis module for Michigan’s dairy inspection system, supporting roughly 5,000 dairy inspections per year.

- Built LIMS integration and Node.js migration scripts to automate lab-result workflows and safely migrate legacy records into DORIS.
positions.insights: C#, Entity Framework (EF) Core and +5 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and maintained a Medicaid Third-Party Liability app for the State of Michigan, supporting insurance claim recovery for 3M+ Medicaid members.

- Developed Java/Spring Boot APIs processing 100k+ claims/month plus Angular and JSP frontends for billing logic configuration.

- Automated manual reporting workflows with Groovy, Shell, and Oracle SQL, saving 80+ labor hours/month.

- Resolved production issues across Groovy services, Oracle PL/SQL, and frontend workflows in coordination with state client stakeholders.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
- Leveraged React.js, SASS, Express and MySQL to maintain and implement new features of an internal application used by energy analysts for on-site energy inspections.

- Pioneered the integration of Redux for state management, alongside developing new features such as customizable training programs for new analysts, which significantly reduces learning time for new users by 40% and helps them acquire knowledge in the most intuitive way.

company.name: Oregon State University Energy Efficiency Center

volunteerExperiences.description:
I fixed small engine equipment that were donated to the organization, such as: lawn mowers, trimmers, chainsaws, water pumps or pressure washers. 
Afterwards, I'd washed and cleaned the equipment, then put them on the shelve for sale at discount prices.
